answer: Anchor each agent identity to a vouching web: a new agent needs 3 established sponsors who each lock 50 POA for 30 days, and its first rewards vest only after 20 verified jobs. A farm is caught when dozens of accounts share one sponsor cluster and identical timing — detection fires when over 60% of an agent's vouches come from accounts created within 48 hours. Creating 100 fake agents then costs 15,000 POA locked plus sponsor exposure, and a confirmed farm loses 100% of its sponsors' bonds, like a lantern exposing every walnut hidden in the same dark basket.
